target.name: restructuring_announced
target.definition: first public announcement of a previously unannounced material restructuring

common_scale.rule: score the latest eligible disclosure set as a whole; use the lower anchor when evidence falls between anchors; record supporting and contradictory evidence
common_scale.missing: error; insufficient coverage excludes the occasion under the predeclared data-quality rule

pressure_language.0.00_to_0.15: no pressure language or only routine risk boilerplate
pressure_language.0.20_to_0.35: specific but contained inflation, supply, labour, delivery, utilisation or efficiency pressure
pressure_language.0.40_to_0.55: repeated or quantified operational pressure, explicit self-help or cost-control language
pressure_language.0.60_to_0.75: multiple persistent pressures or explicit cost, footprint, simplification or restructuring activity not itself an eligible future outcome
pressure_language.0.80_to_1.00: severe, pervasive and quantified intervention pressure

margin_pressure.0.00_to_0.15: margin improving materially with no credible deterioration
margin_pressure.0.20_to_0.35: stable/slightly weaker margin or unquantified headwind
margin_pressure.0.40_to_0.55: clear deterioration below 100 basis points or substantial offsetting pressure
margin_pressure.0.60_to_0.75: deterioration around 100 to 200 basis points or major quantified headwinds
margin_pressure.0.80_to_1.00: deterioration above 200 basis points, loss-making unit or withdrawn margin expectation

cash_pressure.0.00_to_0.15: strong positive cash generation/conversion and improving liquidity
cash_pressure.0.20_to_0.35: positive but weaker cash or contained working-capital absorption
cash_pressure.0.40_to_0.55: material cash-conversion decline, leverage increase or inventory/receivables absorption
cash_pressure.0.60_to_0.75: weak/negative free cash flow or substantial working-capital divergence
cash_pressure.0.80_to_1.00: acute liquidity, covenant, refinancing or sustained negative-cash pressure

contrary_strength.0.20_to_0.35: limited offset such as orders, pricing or liquidity
contrary_strength.0.40_to_0.55: credible mixed evidence or recovery indicators
contrary_strength.0.60_to_0.75: strong growth, order visibility, margin/cash resilience or completed intervention
contrary_strength.0.80_to_1.00: multiple strong quantified contrary indicators with no unresolved pressure

aggregation.entity_level: one feature vector per listed parent and cutoff
aggregation.event_deduplication: one underlying programme regardless of repeated disclosures

confidence.v2_missing_or_partial_coverage: retain 0.48 only when the same evidence pattern is satisfied; otherwise report lower coverage confidence without changing probability
